evidence_type: Assistant in-memory transcription of the learner-supplied DBeaver result screenshot; no direct database read.
query_type: Single read-only complete twelve-week trajectory; no table created or updated.
selection_policy: Highest 90-day unit total among the accepted A x Z cohort, then ascending item_id for a tie. No hard-coded product identifier, peak-based selection or relabelling. A valid empty cohort yields one EMPTY row with all seven item/week fields NULL.
display_normalization: Units are JSON integers. Weekly and cumulative percentages are canonical numeric strings padded to four decimal places, restoring omitted trailing zeros only. DATE cells use YYYY-MM-DD; the displayed zero-sales checkboxes are normalized to JSON true/false. Both window strings and PASS statuses are preserved in the in-memory ten-column rows.
fingerprint_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 compact JSON with sorted object keys and ensure_ascii=False. Selected-product hash encodes a one-element item_id string list. Trajectory hash encodes chronological rows with units as JSON integers, shares as four-decimal strings or NULL, and zero flags as JSON booleans or NULL. Weekly-units hash encodes the chronological integer vector. Only these digests are saved.
scope: All twelve displayed learner rows and ten fields were transcribed only in memory.
